name: Beating My Wife
overview: Scripture calls husbands to love their wives deeply and tenderly, as seen in Ephesians 5:28 where loving one's wife is equated with loving oneself, and Colossians 3:19 which commands husbands to love their wives without bitterness. This divine standard of love stands in stark contrast to any form of harm or abuse, emphasizing care and respect within marriage. Trusting in the Lord provides strength and guidance for husbands to fulfill this loving role, as reflected in Psalms 11:1.
